summary: The FPC Staff used Trout Unlimited's data to contextualize the significance of trout stream losses, noting that the project's inundation would cause a complete loss of trout stream waters in the affected area and that trout streams are a limited resource in South Carolina.
text:
Trout Unlimited, in its letter of comment, indicated that the State's trout streams are now limited to about 250 miles, much of which is considered marginal.
Reductions of coldwater habitat in Lake Jocassee (Section 3.2.2.3) would have an adverse impact on the two-story fishery
